metadata.dataset: BWCAW portages and connectors as carried in the USDA Forest Service National Forest System Trails service (EDW_TrailNFSPublish_01)
metadata.coverage_note: 26 named portages/connectors, 0.03-3.67 mi each, along the Border Route / BWCAW tread; each verified meeting the NCT at 0-44.7 m (inventory section G). Three TrailNFS spellings kept as-is: 'BRT-CLEARWATER LK CAMPSITE TRL', 'BRT-PARTIDGE CAMPSITE', and 'CLEARWATER/DANIELS LAKE'.
